title: Atlas Human Quality Review
description: Structured human review of an Atlas canonical record, used by the quality-calibration framework (scripts/calibrate_quality.py) to measure how well the automated quality_score.py heuristic agrees with human judgment. This artifact is a REVIEW INPUT, never a dataset record; it is keyed by the reviewed record's id and must NOT change the size or content of raw/curated data.

record_id.description: id of the reviewed canonical record (must resolve to a real record in curated/v0.1/pilot_candidates.jsonl).

category.description: Category of the reviewed record; used for bias analysis. Must be an Atlas category enum.

source_id.description: Source registry id (metadata/source_registry.json) the record was traced to. Used for source-bias analysis.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identifier / initials. Multiple reviewers on the same record enables agreement stats.

human_score.description: Human-assigned overall quality, 1-10, on the SAME scale as quality_score.py.

dimension_scores.description: Human scores (1-10) per Atlas quality dimension. Mirrors scripts/quality_score.py WEIGHTS keys.

verdict.description: Accept/reject decision on the record under the v0.1 gate (quality_score>=7 AND verified==true).

hallucination.description: True if the human found any hallucinated or factually wrong claim in the assistant answer.

confidence.description: How confident the human is in their score (1-5). Used as a weight in calibration accuracy.
